intro.title: The pieces that bring it to life
intro.text: Six hand-made pieces, in code: they move only while on screen, respond to pointer, touch and keyboard, and stay still if you asked for less motion.

stack.title: The stack
stack.text: The craft in five layers. Click a layer, or its name, and the ones above lift so you see it whole. Escape closes it.

verbs.title: Verbs in pills

counter.title: Counter

light.title: Cursor light
light.text: A light follows the pointer and switches on what it touches. On touch screens it stays still.

meta.title: Illustration and icon kit · IG System v2
meta.description: How Ignacio Gauna's new portfolio is drawn: its own icons, isometric illustration, stamps and 3D, with their rules of use.

intro.title: How everything is drawn
intro.text: Four languages, all hand-made and in code: icons, isometric figures, stamps and 3D. Each with its rules, so that whatever comes next looks drawn by the same hand.

icons.title: Icons
icons.text: A set of 42 icons of our own on a single grid. Interface glyphs are one stroke; concept icons carry a single piece of colour, like the dot of the monogram.
rules: A 24 × 24 grid and a 1.75 stroke with round ends, in the text colour.
One accent per concept icon: the piece the idea is about.
Sizes 16, 20, 24 and 32 px. At 16 px only interface glyphs are used.
They always sit next to their name; alone, they carry a label for screen readers.
No brand logos: a technology is its name in type and a concept glyph.

figure.title: Isometric illustration
figure.text: The object is the explanation: instead of boxes and arrows, a recognisable machine whose working is the idea. This one was drawn with the repo's figure kit, in the system's colours.
figure.name: The test gauge
figure.hint: Move the pointer or use the arrow keys
figure.alt: A dial gauge on a surface plate. A magnetic base holds a post and an arm; the arm carries a dial indicator whose plunger rests on five blocks, one per change, on a carriage that runs on two rails. Wherever the carriage stops, the plunger rises to the block under it, the needle turns by the same amount and a lamp says whether the reading falls inside the tolerance band.

labels.stage: The test gauge: the arrow keys bring each change under the needle

keys.lit: Plunger and needle: what moves when the reading changes
keys.band: The tolerance band and the lamp that reads it

figure.caption: Every change goes under the gauge before it ships. The needle shows its reading: inside the band the lamp stays green and the change goes on to production; outside it, it goes back for adjustment. That is how my main projects work: CI runs the tests before the build.
rules: Solids, not wireframes: every part is painted and hides what is behind it.
Four tones per face and a single lit accent: the thing to watch.
Every line ends on something: a face, another line or a dot.
Detail belongs to a part: screws, knurls, rulers with their ticks.
Everything that moves and every number comes from the same model.

three.title: 3D
three.text: The same language in three dimensions: the five layers as dark slabs with a rim of light in their colour. Drag it to turn it.
three.label: The five layers of the craft in 3D. Drag or use the arrow keys to turn them.
rules: An orthographic camera, at the same angle as the illustrations.
Dark materials and a rim of light in the layer's colour; colour never fills.
three.js is downloaded only when the scene comes on screen.
It draws on demand: on entering, while dragging and while it coasts. With reduced motion, one still frame.

meta.title: Motion · IG System v2
meta.description: The motion and interaction engine of Ignacio Gauna's new portfolio: entrances, magnetic hover, contextual cursor, shortcuts, scroll and page changes.

intro.title: Motion, with intent
intro.text: How everything in /v2 enters, responds and travels. One engine, mounted once: every frame is asked for by the scroll, the pointer or a key, and everything stops when it arrives.

reveal.title: Entrances
reveal.text: What sits further down enters as it reaches the screen, one by one and in order. What is already in view does not wait: it is there from the start.

magnetic.title: Magnetic hover
magnetic.text: The action leans toward the mouse and settles back when it leaves. It adds to the button's own movement.

cursor.title: Contextual cursor
cursor.text: The system cursor stays; a ring of light follows it, takes the colour of the area and says what a click does.
cursor.touch: With a mouse: on touch screens the finger leads.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.text: One key per action, with its help on «?». They never fire while you type, and the same help turns them off.

scroll.title: Scroll-linked
scroll.text: The scroll moves the scene: the layers part and the line draws as you go down, and they stay still when you stop.
scroll.caption: The five layers, at the pace of the scroll.

camera.title: Page changes
camera.text: Changing page moves the camera: forward in menu order, the new page comes in from the right; backward, from the left; the system pages arrive in depth. The header stays still and its light travels.

rules.title: Rules
items: Only transform, opacity, clip-path and stroke-dashoffset are animated.
Nothing runs off screen or in a loop: every frame is asked for by the scroll, the pointer or a key.
One curve and three durations: 150 ms to respond, 400 to change state and 700 to enter.
With reduced motion everything reaches its final frame at once; without JavaScript, the content is already there.

help.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.intro: They work across the portfolio, except while you type in a field.
help.off: Off: the help stays at hand in the foot of every page.

meta.title: Music · IG System v2
meta.description: Three generative musics for Ignacio Gauna's new portfolio, made with code: one motif per page.

intro.title: Music made with code
intro.text: Three generative musics, each with its place on the site. Nothing is recorded: the code writes every note as it plays, with a motif of its own for each page. It only plays if you turn it on.

marea.name: Tide
marea.line: Ambient: long pads, an arpeggio that comes and goes like the sea, and a soft wave of noise.

circuito.name: Circuit
circuito.line: Pulse: a sixteenth-note arpeggio that runs like code, an eighth-note bass, soft kick and hats.

taller.name: Workshop
taller.line: Lo-fi: electric piano in sevenths, a walking bass, a short melody and brushes, swung.

zones.title: One motif per page
zones.text: Each page has its key, its mode, its four bars and its music: Circuit is the sound of the site, Workshop plays on Work and Tide on the two calmest pages. When the page changes the music finishes the bar and carries on in the new one, with a bell.

rules.title: Rules
items: Off by default: it only plays if you turn it on with the sound button, and the choice is remembered on the device.
It pauses when the tab is hidden and picks up when you come back.
Nothing recorded or downloaded: a few KB of code write every note, and the engine only loads when you turn it on.
Low volume, with a compressor at the end: it never clips.
On iPhone it follows the phone's silent switch.

meta.title: Gate · IG System v2
meta.description: The gate of Ignacio Gauna's new portfolio and the 3D studies that came before it.

choose.title: The gate and its studies
choose.text: The way into the portfolio. “Kinetic” is the one that greets whoever arrives: 2D motion graphics around the monogram, with changes of colour. Below are the four 3D studies made before it, each a scene on the same studio of lights. They all fit one screen on any device, build themselves with the real loading of the page and open with Enter.

cinetica.name: Kinetic
cinetica.piece: The coral dot of the IG is a ball with a life of its own: it drops and bounces, raises the stem, the G rolls in and bumps it, and the monogram hops to its place. Every landing changes the colour of the whole screen: ink, coral, blue, paper. At rest, the letters of the name jump under the pointer and the monogram changes the colour when pressed.
cinetica.loading: One act per loading step, and a fine meter below.

monograma.name: Monogram
monograma.piece: The IG monogram as a sculpture of polished metal, standing on the mirrored floor. It turns with the pointer and reflects the lights of the studio.
monograma.loading: It draws itself stroke by stroke: the stem, the G, its bar and, last, the coral dot that ignites and sends a ripple across the floor.

codigo.theme: Programming: the craft in five layers
codigo.piece: Five slabs of dark lacquer in exploded view, each with its rim of light and its own drawing: a board, lines of code, a graph of agents, rows of checks and a pipeline.
codigo.loading: The slabs come down one at a time, from the bottom up, each bringing its name.

ascenso.name: Ascent
ascenso.piece: Four platforms spiral upward, one per stage of the plan (Core, Cybersecurity, Quant, Aerospace), up to the fifth, where the monogram waits.
ascenso.loading: A point of light climbs one stage per step and lights each platform as it lands; at the top, the dot of the monogram ignites.

postal.loading: They are dealt from behind the camera, one stop after another, each with its year and its name.
